source.publication: Instructions for 2025 PIT-ADJ; 2025 PIT-1 Personal Income Tax Return Instructions; 2025 Tax Rate Table (Tax Look Up Table)
source.section: PIT-ADJ instructions PDF page 7, line 25, Table 2 and Examples 1 and 2; Form PIT-1 lines 9 to 18 and 22; instructions PDF page 25, line 12; Tax Rate Table PDF pages 1 to 6, rows; PDF page 7 (T-7), over 100,000

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 91,000.00 + taxable Social Security (85% of gross 40,000.00) 34,000.00 = 125,000.00. Federal taxable income = 125,000.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 99,375.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; Form PIT-1 takes only the federal line 12 amount, and no line for what the federal return subtracts after line 12). Form PIT-1, head of household. Line 9 federal AGI 125,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (standard deduction taken). Line 11 additions 0.00. Line 12 federal standard deduction 25,625.00. Line 13 dependents 0.00. Line 14 0.00: federal AGI 125,000.00 is over the worksheet's printed ceiling 55,000.00 for this status, so the worksheet is not completed. Line 15, PIT-ADJ: line 13 age 65 or older: Table 1 (head of household) row for federal AGI 125,000.00 gives 0.00 x 1 qualifying = 0.00; line 25 Social Security: federal AGI 125,000.00 does not exceed the Table 2 maximum 150,000.00 (head of household), so the 34,000.00 included in AGI is exempt = 34,000.00; PIT-ADJ line 28 total 34,000.00. Line 17 = 125,000.00 + 0.00 - 25,625.00 - 0.00 - 34,000.00 = 65,375.00. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 99,375.00 - 34,000.00 = 65,375.00; less base deductions 0.00 gives 65,375.00. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 8,000.00 = 120 + 3.2% x 17,000.00 = 544 + 4.3% x 25,000.00 = 1,075 + 4.7% x 15,375.00 = 722.625; total 2,461.625, to the cent 2,461.63. The table row over 65,300 to 65,400 gives 2,460; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 19 to 21 0.00. Line 22 net New Mexico income tax 2,461.63. Head of household has the 150,000 limit, so AGI 125,000.00 keeps the exemption that a single filer would lose.
